name: nav-kurd
description: Mobile-first Kurdistan map with multilingual search, GPS navigation, satellite context, local PMTiles data and owner-managed places.

scripts.data:prepare:core: node tools/build/generate-pwa-manifest.mjs && node tools/release/prepare-android-download.mjs && python3 tools/data/align-data-release.py && python3 tools/data/build-compact-runtime.py && python3 tools/data/build-language-runtime.py && node tools/data/build-locality-language-deltas.mjs && node tools/data/optimize-search-runtime.mjs && node tools/data/build-compact-search-runtime.mjs && node tools/data/generate-atlas-marker-assets.mjs && node tools/data/generate-atlas-icon-bundle.mjs && python3 tools/data/build-viewport-poi-shards.py && node tools/data/update-release-metadata.mjs && node tools/data/update-runtime-sprite-release.mjs && node tools/data/generate-source-integrity-manifest.mjs && node tools/release/generate-release-manifest.mjs
scripts.data:sync: node tools/data/with-source-data.mjs --sync npm run data:prepare:core && node tools/release/generate-release-manifest.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run data:prepare && npm run build:web && npm run build:offline && npm run verify:production
scripts.verify:static: npm run verify:syntax && npm run verify:source && npm run verify:styles && npm run verify:data && npm run verify:runtime && npm run verify:security && npm run verify:platform && npm run verify:pmtiles
scripts.verify:production: npm run verify:static && npm run verify:dependencies && npm run verify:release
scripts.verify: npm run data:prepare && npm run verify:production
scripts.verify:final: npm run build && npm run verify:browser && npm audit --omit=dev
scripts.build:ios:web: npm run typecheck && npm run data:prepare && npm run build:web && npm run build:offline && node tools/build/prepare-native-dist.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:ios:web && npx cap sync ios && npm run verify:platform
scripts.build:android:web: npm run typecheck && npm run data:prepare && npm run build:web && npm run build:offline && node tools/build/prepare-native-dist.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android:web && npx cap sync android && npm run verify:platform
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:windows:web: npm run typecheck && npm run data:prepare && npm run build:web && npm run build:offline && node tools/build/prepare-native-dist.mjs
scripts.windows:bundle: npm run build:windows:web && npx tauri build --bundles nsis,msi
